name: Keep the promise
text: You said you would. Others planned around it.

name: Tell the whole truth
text: Leaving something out is also a choice.

name: Protect the newcomer
text: The person with least standing has most to lose.

name: Share the credit
text: The work was not only yours.

name: Ask before acting
text: The people affected have not been asked yet.

name: Follow the rule
text: The rule was agreed before anyone knew who it would bind.
